notes.title: Full Release Update Log (V1.0)
notes.content:
Dear Challengers,

After a long wait, the major update for Siege of Dungeon has finally been completed! This time, we bring not only new relics, skills, and enemies, but also the highly anticipated new character, the ""Berserker,"" to this perilous dungeon! Whether you are a new challenger or an experienced warrior, this update holds exciting surprises for you!

During the period from early access to official launch, we have added:
- Over 60 relics
- 15 or more skills and unlockable ultimate skills
- Dungeon challenge system
- Character enhancements, new skills, and relic unlock system
- Brand new character: Berserker
- The true ending of the game

Additionally, we have actively worked on optimizations:
- Adjusting the total number of dungeon levels
- Battle acceleration system, allowing the game to be played at a higher speed
- And various other minor fixes! We look forward to providing you with a better experience!

That concludes the announcement. See you in the dungeon!

Siege of Dungeon Team

notes.title: Update Log (V0.6.01)
notes.content:
Dear Challengers,

We are bringing you the long-awaited major update! In addition to the powerful new relics, we are also introducing three new gameplay mechanics, "Challenge Mode", "Auto Unlock", and "Character Upgrade System", providing new challenges and an overall smoother dungeon experience.

- Challenge Mode: new challenges appear for challengers who have completed the dungeon. Defeat stronger foes to get greater rewards. With 6 levels of difficulties introducing different challenges, the new Challenge Mode is waiting for eager challengers to try it out.
- Auto Unlock: Gain Investigation Points according to the progress after each run. Accumulate points to unlock new skills and relics.
- Character Upgrade System: Earn Upgrade Points by using the characters in the dungeon. Upgrade your characters before the next run, and fight against the strong enemies.
- Reduce the total number of floors from 17 to 11. This change greatly reduces the duration of each run and caters to challengers who like to conquer the dungeon again and again.
- Gate of Challenger appears on several floors. Defeat strong enemies to get different rewards.
- New enemies

Check out the discord server to chat with fellow challengers and provide feedback to our team. See you in the dungeon!

Siege of Dungeon Team

notes.title: Update Log (V0.5.40)
notes.content:
Dear Challengers:

We are bringing you some minor adjustments in this patch, including:
- Rework on the action pattern of Floor 2 and 4 Bosses
- Rework on relics Demonic Staffs, Red Barrel
- Change of effects on several variation X class relics.

We are also testing on tweaking the number of floors in different biomes. Interesting players can join our testing by access the Beta Testing Version.
To opt-in:
1. Right click Siege of Dungeon in your Steam Library
2. Click Properties
3. In the ""Betas"" tab, Select ""Beta Testing"" from the drop-down menu

(The most recent game save will be lost upon switching versions)

We are also preparing other new content. Enjoy the game while waiting for our next Major Update, see you in the dungeon!

Siege of Dungeon Team

notes.title: "Siege of Dungeon" Update plans
notes.content:
Dear Challengers: 

Thank you for playing Siege of Dungeon! After collecting feedback and ideas from players, our team set up some recent update plans for our game: 
- More Unlock Item in Institute of Relics, including more powerful custom skills, and some of them can be upgraded to Burst skills. 
- Adjustment on the number of Dungeon Levels, the time needed for each run will be shortened. You will be able to challenge again and again in a relatively short period of time! 
- New game mode: Challenge Mode, which adds different obstacles to your adventure, together with generous rewards and achievement!
- New relics update, which deepens the current build and brings much more strategic gameplay 

The above items will be progressively updated in recent months, the first update is "Unlock of custom skills and its burst version", remember to challenge the dungeon again with these advanced skills! Besides, we have prepared a few more update items, please stay tuned to our announcement! 

Siege of Dungeon team

notes.title: "Siege of Dungeon" is coming tomorrow!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am Kevin Lau, the producer of "Siege of Dungeon". As a complete novice in game development, I learned game development by myself. Later, I recruited members with the prototype of the game to make the game together. Back to It has been more than 2 years since the development of Siege of Dungeon, with the help of many people along the way... finally! The game is coming to Steam!

On the last day before the official release, let me introduce our game we have been work so hard on! Combining the popular rogue elements in recent years and the turn-based battles commonly used in traditional RPGs, the random elements coupled with the traditional combat system make the whole game experience completely different! Although the work may not be comparable to the production of a large team, if you play patiently, you will definitely find all kinds of fun in the game. Here, we sincerely invite you to try to play "Siege of Dungeon" and break through this malicious dungeon!

Looking forward to meeting you in the dungeon on January 12th! Challenger!

Kevin Lau

notes.title: May Dev Log
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42362149/86de837dd129c6c193c58b68f76091f5fb52e00b.png[/img]
Hello everyone, this time we want to share the production progress of Siege of Dungeon. We aim to launch a demo at the Steam Next Festival in June. Thanks to your support, things are going smoothly so far.

Now, let me briefly describe the work we did in the previous months.

[h2]Art[/h2]
We have been working on the art so long since the end of our Kickstarter project, here are our main updates:

[h3]1. Increase the number of original monsters[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42362149/2ada62dd0e2dafe251890a5b83a54cfebeca9bdc.png[/img]
Enemies living in differnt biomes
We finished all the enemies, including their attack, death, or hurt animations. You will see the monster living in level 1, the settlement of goblins, in our demo version. But we promised that there will be plenty of new enemies waiting for you in our completed version.

[h3]2. Scene Art[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42362149/d6ad173a38ea2d57c978b84e3fd99da08c5298e1.png[/img]
Scene art
Besides, we are glad to have our new artist Fisk drawing dungeon scenes for us. Now, we can start our adventure in a more exquisite dungeon!

[h3]3. UI/UX[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42362149/89d8b81897cc6b6496c23140700da159ced1f4ad.png[/img]
Battle UI
UI/UX is one of the weaknesses of our team and we tried our best to make our UI handy and clean. The UI you see in the demo version is much better than that in the Kickstarter preview.

[h2]Game mechanism[/h2]
The enhancement of the game system takes us some time too. We are finally satisfied with the demo version after many trials.

[h3]1. Relics[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42362149/c29095a6c3c9ae584650db4cc0756189136853bb.png[/img]
Each relics brings different effects to your character
You can now collect assorted relics during your adventure in the dungeon. The power of previous challengers will combine and give you great help in your journey!

[h3]2. Battlefield[/h3]
We designed a brand new system “battlefield system” to take the place of the “team system”. Characters nearby will join the fight on the battlefield.

We did many other modifications in our game too, for example:
-Reducing the map size of each level and increasing the total number of dungeon
-Removal of item system
-New interactable objects in dungeon, such as runestone and NPC
-Battle logic modification
-Event system rework
-Reward system rework

Eventually, thank you again for your great support in Siege of Dungeon. Our team is still immature and lacks experience, therefore we are so behind in our work. We have to apologize for our delayed schedule and update again, but we are still working hard on the production of Siege of Dungeon. Please look forward to our demo version.

Thank you for your great support.

Team Siege of Dungeon
